|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2, in date order) of the Virtual Modern Holo Alternate Image card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Darth Tyranus (Holo AI) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the PC card image of this version ([[:File:V13-D-darthtyranusholo_ai-2021-11-11.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing of the Holo Alternate Image card; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and a re-made image is its own version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page, 11 November 2021): PC card image uploaded 11 November 2021<ref name="ht-tyranus-holo-2021">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/darthtyranusholo_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image), [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/db69e725e1573252cbb01232d9d6622b26c16dea commit db69e72] (11 November 2021) (“Holo AIs”); card-size copy [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6e26994c2b33acbdd60c26ee2a3df870e22480c1/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthtyranusholo_ai.gif darthtyranusholo_ai.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6e26994c2b33acbdd60c26ee2a3df870e22480c1 6e26994] (11 November 2021). The card-size file was re-saved on 5 July 2022 (commit a41bae9, “fixing sizes”) with identical pixels, so that is not a new version. The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark and no “(AI)” label. Text: “Deploys -1 to an [Episode I] location. Jedi here are power and immunity to attrition -1. During battle or lightsaber combat involving Dooku, may cancel and redraw an opponent's just drawn destiny. Immune to Sorry About The Mess and attrition < 6.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Tyranus (Holo AI) (Errata)]], 26 January 2025): PC card image uploaded 26 January 2025<ref name="ht-tyranus-holo-2025">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/darthtyranusholo_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image), [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/1bbafcff4f1010e91306c29c21b72ad10518c00e commit 1bbafcf] (26 January 2025) (“2022 Holo AI Fixes”); card-size copies [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/7ecf5604f70f5d0cf57e5bb451035bd5b1c0bc1c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthtyranusholo_ai.gif darthtyranusholo_ai.gif] and the identical [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/7ecf5604f70f5d0cf57e5bb451035bd5b1c0bc1c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/darthtyranus_ai.gif darthtyranus_ai.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/7ecf5604f70f5d0cf57e5bb451035bd5b1c0bc1c 7ecf560] (26 January 2025). The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”. Text: “Deploys -1 to an [Episode I] location. Jedi here are power and immunity to attrition -1. During battle or lightsaber combat involving Dooku, may cancel and redraw an opponent's just drawn destiny. Immune to Sorry About The Mess and attrition < 6.” '''What changed''' (compared with the image of 11 November 2021): the card was re-made in the PC's 2025 Holo AI fixes; the Players Committee logo and the label “(AI)” now print in the bottom right corner. The words are the same. It is the current image.
